CONG CLAUDE - can_nguoi=true, qwen KHONG chay, chi hien ra va cho `q xong <ma>`.
Truong bat buoc: ma, ten, lan, uu_tien, ngay, lenh (hoac soan_ma), cong.
lan     TESTER | CPU | LLM | MANG | NHE     -> quyet dinh chay song song bao nhieu

phu_thuoc  danh sach `ma` phai XONG truoc.
cong    do `qwen/cong.py` cham bang CODE. qwen KHONG duoc tu phan DAT.
lap     so lan chay lai toi da (mac dinh 1). Dung cho vong lap doc/boc.
can_nguoi  true = KHONG tu chay, chi hien ra cho chu du an.
RANG BUOC VAT LY - khong duoc pha:
lan TESTER toi da 1 viec. `chay_tester_kho` ghi de CUNG mot file
MQL5/Experts/<TEN_EA>.mq5 + cung mot .ini + cung mot .xml, va chi co MOT
terminal64.exe. Hai viec tester chay cung luc thi ket qua cua nhau bi
ghi de, va khong ai bao loi - dung y het mot ket qua that.

viec.ten: Do dia truoc khi cho tester chay - bay B4 cua 08/09
viec.vi_sao: Tester treo 2 gio, tieu 12 giay CPU, log ghi 'low disk space'. C: chi con 13,4 GB. Do TRUOC moi phien tester, dung doi no treo roi moi doan.
lenh: import shutil,sys,json,pathlib; u=shutil.disk_usage('C:/'); g=u.free/1e9; print('C: free %.2f GB'%g); pathlib.Path('reports/QWEN_DIA.json').write_text(json.dumps({'dong':[{'o':'C','gb':round(g,2)},{'o':'F','gb':round(shutil.disk_usage('F:/').free/1e9,2)}]}),encoding='utf-8'); sys.exit(0 if g>6 else 3)
viec.ghi_chu: Thoat ma 3 = con duoi 6 GB. KHONG duoc tu xoa AppData\Local\Google (13,7 GB) hay Apple Computer (5,7 GB) - do la du lieu cua chu du an, phai hoi.

viec.ten: THUONG TRUC: chay bo test cua lab (4 cai dang HONG tu truoc dot nay)
viec.vi_sao: Do 08/09 truoc khi giao cho qwen: 1.239 pass / 4 FAIL / 673 giay. Bon cai do KHONG phai do he `q` sinh ra, va deu chan viec dang nam trong bang: (1) `gann_sq9` khai trong CHI_BAO_CO ma goi khong duoc (KeyError) - nen viec 'dua Gann vao mot gia thuyet that' o muc E.5 chua chay duoc; (2)+(3) banker thieu khoi `tin_dung` / `tin_dung_that`; (4) hien phap: 6 module chua co test (nhan/dich_mq5*.py, doi_khung.py, quan_tri_dsl.py - deu tu phien 07/09). Chay lai moi ngay de biet con so 4 do TANG hay GIAM.
viec.ghi_chu: Cong nay AM khi con test hong - do la am THAT, khong phai chua do duoc. Bon cai dang hong deu can SUA MA nen he khong tu sua; qwen chi bao so va viet vao nhat ky.

viec.ten: THUONG TRUC: qwen doc toan van + boc co che (moi luot toi da 5 gio)
viec.vi_sao: Day la viec DUNG de giao cho may: khoi luong thuan, loi bi `them_co_che` chay tren du lieu that bat lai. Do 08/09: con 3.320 tai lieu chua DOC, 7.919 chua BOC, 4.316 artifact. Mot luot khong vet duoc - phai lap, nen viec nay THUONG TRUC: chay lai moi 1 gio cho den khi ton kho canh that.
viec.ghi_chu: Neu log ra 'ung vien 0 NHUNG kho con N tai lieu chua doc' thi day la KHAU DOC HONG, khong phai het ton kho. Bao ngay, dung chay tiep.

viec.ten: THUONG TRUC: qwen boc co che tu file CHI BAO (hang doi KHAC TT_boc)
viec.vi_sao: Chay SONG SONG duoc voi L2 vi no doc danh sach file .mq5 CHI BAO, con L2 doc bang `tai_lieu` - hai hang doi khac nhau, khong gianh nhau ban ghi. Va 190/389 file ma la CHI BAO, chua tung vao khau boc ('70%' that ra la 32%).
viec.ghi_chu: File nao tra RONG thi thu lai bang qwen3.6-flash (yield cao hon). Va kiem `completion_tokens` co sat tran khong truoc khi ket luan mo hinh kem - max_tokens thap lam mo hinh bi cat giua chung roi ra 0, doc y het 'mo hinh kem'.

viec.ten: THUONG TRUC: tai ma nguon MQL5 Code Base (nguon DUY NHAT co file chay tester ngay)
viec.vi_sao: Nguon DUY NHAT co file chay tester duoc ngay. Do 20:07 08/09: MQL5 KHONG bi chan - nhin thay 80, tai duoc 78. Nhung ghi_moi=0 vi con tro dang o trang 4 va trang do da boc roi. Con tro TIEN mot trang moi luot (config/ma_nguon_con_tro.json) nen viec nay phai LAP moi di sau duoc; 3 gio/luot = ~8 trang/ngay.
lenh:
import sys, json, pathlib; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from nhan import ma_nguon as MN
r = MN.thu_thap(so_bai=40)
print(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)[:3000])
pathlib.Path('reports/QWEN_MA_NGUON.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False, default=str), encoding='utf-8')
viec.ghi_chu: Cong do `ghi_moi` chu khong do 'chay xong' - mot luot tai 78 file trung het la AM THAT (khong them duoc gi), khac han chay hong. Ham la `thu_thap(so_bai=)`, KHONG co `mot_luot`. `thu_thap` ghi vao bang `artifact` CHU KHONG vao `tai_lieu` - dem nham bang thi tuong nhu that bai.

viec.ten: Doi chung EA switch vs EA nhieu-slot tren D1 voi 40 slot

viec.ghi_chu: Chua co script. Doc `nhan/dich_mq5_ghep.py` va `nhan/dich_mq5.py`, viet ban nhap ra qwen/nhap/, roi chu du an duyet moi chay.

viec.ten: THUONG TRUC: day chuyen san nguon moi (seeker -> doc -> boc)
viec.vi_sao: Hai viec vet kho tren se can sau vai ngay; day chuyen san thi khong, vi dau vao la Internet. Chay o lan MANG nen KHONG tranh terminal64 voi lan tester - do 30/08: doc trang qua trinh duyet an 4,2% CPU.
viec.ghi_chu: MQL5 bi chan vi DNS tren mang nay - bat Cloudflare WARP (`b mang`) truoc. Nguon CO FILE (.mq5/.ex5/.set) uu tien hon van xuoi vi chay tester duoc ngay.
